seo.title: Menu — Coffee, Matcha, Food & Sweets
seo.description: Babaloo Coffee Club menu: espresso drinks, cold brew, ceremonial matcha, smoothies, sandwiches, pan de bono and homemade sweets. Order online in Charlotte, NC.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.text:
Babaloo is a little devotion to the everyday. A place for familiar faces and new ones.
For coffee that turns into conversation, quick stops that take a little longer,
and dogs we know by name. Nothing here is too serious. Nothing is by accident.
